task.title: Issue 2 — Compact runtime, queue, task, and skill-route context outputs
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime task/queue/state inspection surfaces return compact summaries by default and do not dump full completed task history or full queue job payloads unless explicitly requested.
Full runtime dumps require an explicit includeHistory-style option.
Skill auto-route and related prompt/context echo surfaces summarize and truncate original prompts by default.
Regression tests reproduce large task/evidence history and prove compact bounded output.

planning.reason: Emergency runtime-output safety fix requested after raw task/context dumps entered chat.

redGreenEvidence.redSummary: Initial queue-runner validation failed on missing compact helper wiring; regression then failed because compact inspect output remained too large.
redGreenEvidence.greenSummary: Queue-runner/core/skill-routing/static/compile validations passed; live skill-routing validation also passed.
